points: When Jabin king of Hazor heard those things, he sent to Jobab king of Madon, to the kings of Shimron and Achshaph, and to the kings of the north, to the Canaanite, the Amorite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Jebusite, and the Hivite under Hermon.

note.label: Joshua 11: The Northern Kings Utterly Destroyed
